evidence.text:
In general, no. We would however advise that legal advice is sought before disseminating written
marketing materials in the Cayman Islands, so that the specific facts and circumstances may be
considered to determine whether such dissemination would have any consequences under Cayman
Islands law. As it is a question of fact whether such dissemination is likely to trigger the Foreign
Company Registration Requirement or the Securities Investment Business Licensing Requirement
this should therefore be analysed on a case-by-case basis.
